lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Denise Chopra is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Denise is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d41: 🕯️ Denise Chopra is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Denise kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Denise's gone." Dzifa looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Denise." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Naomie blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Grave Robber (Level 1). You can loot the dead (villagers, monsters). Good gear. -15 trust if seen.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Denise Chopra, 41 days. The mantle passes to Naomie Ndombe.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Naomie Ndombe, 21 — a Wild food forager. Her hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Bird Whisperer.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Denise — and Denise is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Penelope, Dzifa, Dmitri and 3 more speak for Naomie — "Denise trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Naomie before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d111: — DAY 111 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d111: 👀 Chantal claims to belong somewhere — then spends the whole evening oriented around something they won't name. The wanting is real. The word for it isn't "to belong somewhere".
d111: Dzifa Amartey reads the sky: clear tomorrow, freezing.
d111: Dzifa kneels and asks. The land answers: 7 bellies full in Haven today. (Feed the Multitude)
d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+11 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
